tasks.elf3_dwaq_consistent_v1: mean actor context and newest critic foot force; ideal velocity observation
tasks.elf3_dwaq_feedback_v1: same consistency fixes plus 20 Hz Tustin velocity-observation model at 200 Hz physics

feedback_model.status: first-order 20 Hz hypothesis motivated by existing real q/dq data, not a full identified servo model
feedback_model.reset: input and output initialized to current post-reset joint velocity
feedback_model.deployment: use existing hardware-reported velocity; do NOT add another filter

formal_command: bash elf3.sh scripts/train_elf3_feedback.py --task elf3_dwaq_feedback_v1 --headless --num-envs 4096 --iterations 100001 --run-name feedback_scratch_4096_seed42 --swanlab-project DWAQ
resume: explicit --resume requires an identical new experiment contract; initial random/test/old-version weights are not formal starting points
resume_command: bash elf3.sh scripts/train_elf3_feedback.py --task elf3_dwaq_feedback_v1 --headless --device cuda:0 --num-envs 4096 --iterations 100001 --seed 42 --run-name feedback_resume --resume logs/elf3_dwaq_feedback_v1/RUN/model_N.pt --swanlab-project DWAQ
resume_semantics: iterations is the total update count from zero; resume starts at the saved completed index plus one; per-environment physics, random generator and terrain curriculum state are reinitialized
swanlab: New launches create an isolated run; attaching to an existing run uses repair_swanlab_scalars.py with ACK cursors, optional event-log-dir and elapsed-time offset. Never overwrite overlapping scalar steps or run two uploaders for the same state.
play_limitation: The strict training-recipe contract currently rejects generic play.py overrides such as num_envs or terrain; export first for Sim2Sim. No evaluation-time contract relaxation is included.

hardware_observation.source: user report, same robot and deployment, only the model changed
